parts.text: Implement the configured truth-reader architecture now. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation and provide complete contents for every required repository file in files[]. Do not return patches. Preserve the design exactly: authoritative docs untouched; pre-created projection copies with distributed placeholders; enumerated doc1=true style selection; trusted workflow-only Node seeds selected projections after the triggering commit; separate evidence commit returns all seeds; exact deterministic verification; FAIL changes nothing; PASS performs one atomic reset/cleanup commit; prevent recursive workflow triggering. Include the workflow, workflow-only JS, selector/control file, evidence file, catalog/config, and representative projection copies/templates needed for the known required documents.
